engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları(s)
technicalNotes: Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: the J519 (7E0/BCM PQ25), Address [09-Cent. Elect.], Kontrol edin: stored value in the Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon:  Channels [050], [051] and [052] for the "Energy Management". Typically these are set to a value of [0]. If the fault code 04194 does not clear and there is no other cause found, try to [Save] a new value of [0] to each of these channels,[050], [051] and [052] in the J519, even if the value is currently [0]. Then see if the fault code clears. ref: 7E0-937-BCM-V1
